content_blocks.text_he: ה' אמ"ש וז' כפולות בג"ד כפר"ת, וי"ב פשוטות הו"ז חט"י לנס"ע צק"; איך הם בקוי הספירות... לפ"ד הגר"א זלה"ל. והבא הציור הזה במפורש כפ"ה. אל תלמידו הרמ"ש ז"ל.
content_blocks.text_note: Recaps the 3 mothers/7 doubles/12 simples classification, then introduces a diagram showing how the letters sit along the sefirot's lines, per the Gra's opinion. **Transmission attribution (verbatim, provenance-bearing):** the diagram is stated to have gone 'to his disciple, Ramash' (אל תלמידו הרמ"ש ז"ל) -- a named-recipient transmission note. Exact referent of 'כפ"ה' (possibly 'as in chapter 5' or a specific prior printed source) is UNCERTAIN.

**DIAGRAM (MAJOR, described structurally):** A vertical hexagonal/diamond (rhombus-lattice) geometric figure built of a repeating triangular/diamond lattice pattern (resembling a stylized crystal-column or sefirotic-tree diagram), with Hebrew letters labeled at points along it. Legible letter-labels include ה (near the top), כ/ח/ט (upper band), מ/נ (middle), ד/ל (lower-middle), ר/ק (near the bottom), and ס/ז at the outer sides -- connecting (per the accompanying text) the 12 simple letters geometrically along sefirotic 'lines'. No further geometric or numeric labels were confidently resolved beyond these letters.

content_blocks.text_he: ל"ב נתיבות מבעל פרי יצחק
content_blocks.text_note: **MAJOR RESEARCH-DNA HIT -- CONFIRMS DISPATCH HYPOTHESIS, PRECISELY LOCATED.** 'The 32 Paths, by the Author of Peri Yitzchak.' The dispatch's structural map hypothesized 'ל"ב נתיבות ... בעל פרי יצחק' somewhere across pp.204-207; this precisely locates its START at p.207 -- pp.204-206 turn out to be the two 231-gates tables/diagram, not the 32-Paths text itself.
Opens with an introductory paragraph before the numbered path-list begins.

Numbered list of the classic '32 Paths of Wisdom' (a text-form also known from other Kabbalistic works, e.g. Sha'arei Orah): 'הנתיב הראשון' (The First Path)... 'נתיב ב'' (Path 2)... continuing sequentially. Each entry is a short descriptive epithet of a Divine/intellectual quality (e.g., Path 1 read tentatively as 'השכל הראשון... נקרא שכל הפלא, הוא האור הקדמון...' -- 'the Wondrous Intellect, the Primordial Light'; exact wording of each subsequent path not individually verbatim-transcribed at this pass, RESEARCH-DNA preserved at the level of the section's existence and its echo of Mishnah 1's opening line). By the bottom of the visible page, the list reaches approximately 'נתיב י"ח' (Path 18) of the expected 32.

research_dna_flags.text: 'ל"ב נתיבות' section explicitly echoes Mishnah 1's opening line (p.155, 'בשלשים ושתים נתיבות פליאות חכמה') -- the book's opening construct and this appended elaboration close the loop.

unresolved_readings.text: Individual path descriptions beyond Path 1 not transcribed verbatim at this pass (paraphrase-level only, per the depth standard for dense discursive material); exact wording of each of paths 2-18 not independently re-verified.
The 32-Paths list is confirmed MID-ENUMERATION at the batch's stop point (through path ~18 of 32); paths ~19-32 continue into p.208, which is OUT OF SCOPE for this batch and was NOT read.
